analysis.insight_summary: Users face a compatibility issue between software and hardware versions of [product_name], where an error message requires a newer software version. The primary challenge centers on matching product and article numbers, along with confusion over which upgrades are available and how to access them.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want [product_name] software to work seamlessly with their hardware versions, without facing version-related barriers. They expect straightforward upgrade paths and easily accessible update options.
